distractors: In every single case without exception, which is a much stronger claim than it sounds.
At a level of description kept deliberately free of detail, so the shape of a thing is visible and its mechanics are not.
According to the view most of the people in the room hold, offered as the reason a decision should go that way. It reports a headcount rather than a judgement.
Measured across a stretch of time long enough that short-term noise stops mattering, which is how a trend gets separated from a run of bad weeks. It is a claim about duration, not about coverage.

Taken across every part of an organisation rather than inside one team, which is what makes a number comparable between divisions. It widens the frame of a claim from local to enterprise-wide, and it usually raises the stakes of it.
